new_obs_cluster_list_v4.description: Hitting elbow path during forward swing: linear pull across chest vs rotational arc
Height of the hitting hand at preparation relative to the incoming ball
During the forward swing, does the front knee cave inward toward the midline or stay stable/drive outward?
During forward swing, does the front knee drift forward past the toes or stay behind the toes?
At or through contact, does the lead/front foot stay grounded or lift/pivot off the court?
On a volley preparation, whether the racket hand takes a backward swing past the torso or sets stationary in front.
Hand placement along the racket grip relative to butt cap
Width between feet when setting up to hit relative to shoulder width.
At the start of the forward swing, does the racket head drop below the wrist into a lag position?
Depth of ball bounce in opponent court relative to service line and baseline
During forward swing and contact on a one-handed backhand, does the non-hitting arm move backward to counterbalance?
During recovery and ready position, width between the feet relative to shoulder width.
Direction of the hand and racket path through the contact zone
Position of the hitting arm relative to torso rotation during the forward swing
On the return of serve, whether the returner touches the ball or is cleanly aced
During the backswing transition, does the racket drop below the ball in a continuous gravity-assisted loop?
Angle between hitting forearm and racket shaft in the preparation phase
Hitting shoulder elevation (shrug) during preparation and forward swing
Degree of joint flexion at hips and knees during preparation and movement.
Trajectory angle of the racket head through the contact zone
Spine curvature during preparation and swing: is the spine rounded or neutral?
During knee and hip bending on low shots, is the player's spine neutral or rounded into flexion?
Orientation of the racket head relative to the hitting hand at the completion of follow-through
Elbow height relative to hand during follow-through roll
Height of the hitting elbow during the follow-through roll relative to shoulder level
Racket head speed progression during the forward swing into contact
Ball trajectory pace and depth off the racket
Portion of the foot bearing weight during recovery or receiving
Part of the foot making initial contact upon landing from the split step.
At the split step landing, do the heels contact the ground flat or stay elevated?
Post-hit balance recovery: whether the player maintains balance or stumbles and braces against the ground
During or immediately after the stroke, does the player touch the racket to the court surface to maintain balance?
Angle between racket shaft and forearm during follow-through: does the racket flip past the forearm line?
During the follow-through of a slice, does the racket maintain an angle with the forearm or straighten and flip past it?
Forearm pronation or supination rapidly twisting the racket face orientation through contact
Vertical movement of the hitting elbow during forward swing on low balls
During trunk rotation into contact, does the torso appear fluid with dynamic tilt or stiff and upright?
During preparation, is body weight loaded over the back leg before stepping forward?
At the start of the forward swing, is the racket delivered into the slot with the butt cap leading?
At what point does the non-dominant hand release the racket throat on a one-handed backhand?
During the forward swing into contact, does the lead shoulder actively pull the arm forward along the target line?
Height of the hitting hand at the peak of the backswing loop
Foot pressure distribution or ankle eversion/pronation on the back foot during loading
At forward swing initiation, is there dynamic diagonal stretch separation between the hip line and shoulder line?
Direction of hitting elbow and racket extension during forward swing relative to chest facing direction
Within 0.5 s after contact, does the non-dominant foot kick upward or across the body?

aggregation_fix.what: obs_bind.agg: if both runs require two different values of the SAME observable (model meant 'any of', e.g. OBS-16 long/wide/net), that cannot all hold as 'required' (check_obs_binding O3 FAILed it) -> those conditions are demoted to supporting. check_obs_binding O10 re-derives exactly this. Stricter, never adds a required; no rule relaxed.

groups_detail.why_run1: Rotating the trunk continuously through contact instead of decelerating to transfer momentum to the arm.
groups_detail.why_run2: Continuously rotating the trunk through contact rather than decelerating it to transfer momentum to the arm.

groups_detail.why_run1: Pulling or setting the contact point too close to the body instead of extending well out in front.
groups_detail.why_run2: Pulling or setting the racket pull slot too close to the body rather than out in front.

groups_detail.why_run1: Pushing hips and knees forward instead of maintaining a hip hinge with hips back.
groups_detail.why_run2: Allowing hips and knees to drift forward instead of maintaining a hip hinge.

groups_detail.why_run1: Failing to stabilize the scapula with back muscles, detaching the hitting arm from the trunk.
groups_detail.why_run2: Failing to stabilize the scapula with the mid-back musculature, disconnecting the hitting arm from trunk drive.
